entries.english: The Bali branch has taken the pickup request
entries.note: The first row of a parcel sent from Bali, before the branch has it. The brackets name the branch in English.

entries.wording: 【…】巴厘岛分公司已收入 Information Accepted
entries.english: The Bali branch has taken the parcel in
entries.note: The branch holds the parcel.

entries.wording: 全球速运 法国巴黎分公司已收件
entries.english: The Paris branch has received the parcel
entries.note: The first row of a parcel sent from France.

entries.english: Being sorted at the warehouse
entries.note: The brackets name the system's operator.

entries.english: Getting ready for the next stop
entries.note: The brackets name the branch the parcel leaves.

entries.wording: 【…】到达巴厘岛国际港口转运处理中心
entries.english: Arrived at the transit centre of Bali's international port
entries.note: The parcel waits at the port for its ship.

entries.wording: 出口申报完成，正在安排船舶【…】
entries.english: Export declared, a ship is being arranged
entries.note: The brackets repeat the row in English.

entries.wording: 【…】已装船，船舶即将离开巴厘岛国际转运港口，发往中国
entries.english: Loaded on the ship, which is about to leave Bali for China
entries.note: The parcel leaves the origin.

entries.english: On its way to Shanghai, China
entries.note: The brackets repeat the row in English.

entries.english: Arrived at …
entries.note: The brackets name the port of arrival in China.

entries.wording: 已安排提货清关，请耐心等待
entries.english: Collection and customs clearance are arranged, please wait
entries.note: The parcel waits for clearance at the port.

entries.english: Cleared, released by customs
entries.note: Customs released the parcel; it moves on.

entries.wording: 包裹分拣至上海综合保税仓，即将中转国内快递
entries.english: Sorted to the Shanghai bonded warehouse, about to go to a domestic courier
entries.note: The row before the hand-off.

entries.wording: 转送出库，中转国内中通快运，单号：…
entries.english: Sent out, handed to ZTO Freight under number …
entries.note: The hand-off to ZTO Freight, which gives the number the rows above it are under.

entries.english: Handed to ZTO Express under number …
entries.note: The hand-off to ZTO Express, which gives the number the rows above it are under.

entries.english: Arranging the transfer to the next stop
entries.note: The place comes after the text.

entries.english: The parcel is in transit
entries.note: The place comes after the text.

entries.english: Arrived at the transit centre
entries.note: The place comes after the text.

entries.english: Left the transit centre
entries.note: The place comes after the text.

entries.english: Customs status updated
entries.note: A customs scan on the way, at the hub the place names.

entries.english: Waiting for customs clearance
entries.note: The parcel waits for clearance in China.

entries.english: Released by customs
entries.note: Customs released the parcel; it moves on.

entries.english: ZTO Freight has picked the parcel up at …
entries.note: ZTO Freight's first row, copied from its tracker: the parcel was already on its way.

entries.wording: 货物 在 … 装车 下一站 …
entries.english: Loaded at …, next stop …
entries.note: ZTO Freight's row; the first station is where the parcel is.

entries.english: Arrived at …
entries.note: ZTO Freight's row at a sorting centre or the delivery station.

entries.english: Out for delivery from …
entries.note: ZTO Freight's row, which named the courier and a mobile.

entries.english: Your parcel was signed for by the recipient
entries.note: ZTO Freight's delivery: the brackets say who signed and that it was signed for.

entries.english: Picked up in …
entries.note: ZTO Express's first row, without the courier it named: the parcel was already on its way.

entries.english: Sent to …
entries.note: ZTO Express's row; the brackets name the city, the text the station.

entries.english: Arrived at …
entries.note: ZTO Express's row; the brackets name the city, the text the station.

entries.english: Out for delivery from …
entries.note: ZTO Express's row, which named the courier and a mobile.

entries.wording: 您的快件已由【…】 收取
entries.english: Your parcel was taken in by …
entries.note: ZTO Express's delivery: the brackets say who took the parcel.
